layout_sources: https://github.com/Metasaura/ofxstatement-lloyds/blob/main/tests/sample-statement.csv (2023-24 layout: header with trailing comma, rows without, '99-88-74 sort code, newest first, "2000" with no decimals)

notes: Newest first, DD/MM/YYYY. Header ends with a comma (9 fields), data rows do not (8). Sort code written '30-12-34 (leading apostrophe so spreadsheets keep it as text). Separate Debit Amount / Credit Amount (positive), running Balance, no thousands mark, no currency. Whole-pound amounts are sometimes written without decimals ("500"), as in published samples. Type codes DEB, FPI, FPO, DD, BGC. LF line endings as in the samples (not certain). ASCII.
